info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Gap Analysi Analyse-spec
info.description: The Gap Analysis Creation API allows businesses to initiate and manage gap analysis processes in their banking models. This endpoint facilitates the submission of new gap analyses, enabling organizations to identify discrepancies and improve performance. Typical consumers include financial analysts and project teams who require detailed assessments to inform strategic decisions. The API provides essential functionality for creating, tracking, and optimizing analysis efforts in a structured manner.

post.summary: Create a new gap analysis entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new gap analysis entry by submitting relevant data. Ensure that all required fields are completed to successfully create the analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit data for gap analysis analyses. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema for successful processing.
